'''challenger Sitting Duck QMC''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 18 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif|label=Quiet Mining Colony}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 QMC challenger LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Princess Leia (V), Escape Pod (V), Flash Of Insight (V), Civil Disorder (V), Imperial Atrocity (V), Bright Hope (V): no GEMP blueprint)

Sits like a fat 'ol duck.

== Notes ==

* Original-era (V): Escape Pod (V) (VS2); Flash Of Insight (V) (VS5); Princess Leia (V) x2, Civil Disorder (V), Imperial Atrocity (V), Bright Hope (V) (VS6).
* Posted 'Alter (Premiere)' dested Alter (the Premiere and Coruscant Light printings share the title); 'LSJK' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Free Ride/Endor Celeb' Free Ride & Endor Celebration.
* Unique cards posted x2 (Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel; Princess Leia (V); Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; Luke's Lightsaber) dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

Just something you really haven’t seen before- a podracing QMC. I was trying to think of a deck that could really take advantage of I Did It!, and QMC seemed to be the best choice. Otherwise, run it like a normal QMC, flip on turn 2 or 3, and take near squat damage. Combine that with retrieval, and you’re pretty set. Just slooowly drain the opponent out, coupled with the occasional beatdown. You can actually take fairly decent advantage of Civil Disorder (V)- although I would like to add a Senator Palpatine to screw Senate up. Any ideas on how to do that? Also, I’m worried about my lack of Controls. Any ideas? I also want to add STRans (V).

Matchups:

Dark Deal: Fight for space hard- or you’ll lose it.

MKOS: They shouldn’t be able to outdamage you. And if they try to come fight you on Cloud City, let them.

Hunt Down: Choose your battles wisely.

CCT: Killeet Han and Lando.

ROps: He probably won't come to you, and it will be hard for you to go to him, so just enjoy the quiet life on CC.

BHBM: Avoid beats. Give him Luke if he wants it.

AOBS: Keep Luke safe. Protect Luke.

Watto: Spend 8 to use Watto, then TBS the deck.

Combat: If you must Combat, track.

Other things- do your thing.
